sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, d.d_day_name, h.holiday_name, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) OVER () AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) OVER () AS baseline_avg_trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30' AND d.d_dow = 5 ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
